site.title: Ankole
site.description: Ankole is the open-source Agent Harness with a Company Brain—an open-source alternative to Claude Tag where AI Agents handle ongoing work right inside your team's existing chat tools.
hero.badge: Open source · Self-hosted on your infrastructure · From solo teams to enterprises
hero.subtitle: Ankole runs AI Agents that take on ongoing work across your company. They share a Company Brain that remembers what your team has decided, and your people work with them directly in Slack, Microsoft Teams, Lark, DingTalk, or WeCom—an open-source alternative to Claude Tag.
hero.claim.recovery: Long-running tasks survive crashes and restarts
hero.claim.noLockIn: No lock-in to Slack or Claude models
hero.claim.access: Every Agent operates strictly within the permissions you grant

difference.title: A bare model with a prompt and a few tools starts every task from scratch
difference.subtitle: Left on its own, a model forgets what your team decided last week, uses whatever credentials happen to be nearby, and loses all progress if its process dies. Ankole's harness closes those gaps.
difference.function.title: Agents remember what your team decided
difference.function.body: Company Brain learns from team conversations, registered files and URLs, and working notes written by Agents. Every entry retains its source and date: as new evidence arrives, Company Brain updates the current view while preserving the full history.
difference.outcome.title: Corrections and real outcomes improve future work
difference.outcome.body: When people repeatedly correct the same mistake, an Agent can propose a short Skill lesson that takes effect once a human approves it. Company Brain also tracks forecasts and compares them against actual outcomes when they come due.
difference.loop.title: Work wakes up on real events
difference.loop.body: Incoming messages, cron schedules, webhooks, and external events automatically wake the Agent responsible for the work—and an Agent can schedule its own checkbacks to follow up later.
difference.context.title: Long-running work survives crashes
difference.context.body: Tasks can run for hours or days while accepting follow-up steering along the way. If a process fails, the failure stays isolated to that single conversation, and Ankole resumes from the inputs, model tape, and tool receipts stored in PostgreSQL.
difference.governance.title: Every Agent stays within the access you grant
difference.governance.body: Humans and Agents each hold their own identity and permissions, and Agents never share a container, home directory, or credential. Offboarding a person immediately blocks their login and halts the tasks and schedules they own.
compounding.title: Nobody told Ankole to memorize the seven-year rule
compounding.body: Company Brain picked up the rule from a channel Ankole belonged to, recorded its source and date, and applied it automatically the next time a valuation came up. Every authorized Agent works from the same up-to-date company knowledge.
compounding.ledger.title: Company Brain · Research rules
compounding.r1.rule: Cyclical stocks use percentiles from seven years of data
compounding.r1.from: Agreed in a conversation between two colleagues
compounding.r2.rule: Lead with the conclusion and include the risks
compounding.r3.rule: State when data is missing and use only observed values
compounding.r3.from: Written into the skill after an incident
compounding.r4.rule: Value the HK listing separately from the A share listing
compounding.log.p1: Plain vector search retrieves raw message snippets by embedding similarity—often returning an outdated rule right alongside the newer rule that replaced it.
compounding.log.p2: Company Brain instead stores each piece of knowledge as a structured claim with its source, timestamp, confidence, disclosure scope, and holder (the person or Agent behind that view). When new evidence arrives, Company Brain updates the active view while keeping historical claims and surfacing unresolved contradictions for review.
compounding.log.p3: Every new request starts from what your company knows today. Repeated feedback sharpens operational rules, and every forecast stays linked to the real-world outcome that tests it.
compounding.proof.title: We run Company Brain on Ankole's own codebase
compounding.proof.body: An Ankole Agent helps maintain this repository using the exact same Company Brain, tools, and governance rules that ship to users. Every review correction and test outcome refines the context and procedures used in later maintenance.
capabilities.title: Built for ongoing company operations
capabilities.subtitle: Ankole is a complete system rather than an SDK—shipping its own control plane, durable PostgreSQL schema, and isolated Agent computers.
capabilities.async.title: Work keeps running asynchronously
capabilities.async.body: Deep research jobs, scheduled checks, and follow-up reviews keep running long after you close the chat—and pick right back up from PostgreSQL after a restart.
capabilities.tacit.title: Agents capture unwritten team conventions
capabilities.tacit.body: Company Brain distills working rules, preferences, and ruled-out options from chats, registered documents and URLs, and Agent field notes.
capabilities.brain.title: Permission-aware knowledge disclosure
capabilities.brain.body: Before any company knowledge enters a model prompt, Company Brain filters out anything the requester lacks permission to read—and in group chats, it can enforce the intersection of every member's access.
capabilities.research.title: Deep Research tests competing hypotheses
capabilities.research.body: Deep Research gathers evidence across isolated sub-contexts, weighs competing explanations against each other, and delivers a cited report.
capabilities.browser.title: Every Agent gets its own dedicated computer
capabilities.browser.body: Each Agent runs inside its own Linux container with a headless browser, terminal, filesystem, Codex runtime, MCP servers, and Skills—backed by a persistent home directory that survives restarts and image upgrades.
capabilities.skills.title: Repeated feedback turns into Skill lessons
capabilities.skills.body: A Skill defines an approved playbook for a recurring job. After repeated human corrections, an Agent can propose a concise Skill lesson that takes effect as soon as an operator approves it.
capabilities.multi.title: Isolated contexts prevent correlated blind spots
capabilities.multi.body: Workflows fan a problem out across multiple Agents in separate contexts, validate each Agent's typed output, and synthesize the results deterministically.
capabilities.enterprise.title: Full audit trail and per-Agent token quotas
capabilities.enterprise.body: PostgreSQL logs every incoming request, model invocation, and outbound delivery, while per-Agent token quotas cap model spend.
usecases.title: What teams ask Ankole to handle
usecases.subtitle: Requests arrive directly from group channels or direct messages.
usecases.digest.title: Send a weekly digest
usecases.digest.action: Creates a recurring Friday schedule, reads posts from the nine X accounts you specified, groups them by topic, and compiles a PDF.
usecases.digest.result: A formatted PDF posted to the channel every Friday at 17:00
usecases.issue.title: Fix an issue
usecases.issue.action: Runs Codex in a background job using the repository credentials configured by an administrator.
usecases.issue.result: A pull request linked back into the chat
usecases.summary.title: Summarize the week
usecases.summary.action: Reads the channel history it is authorized to view and extracts open action items.
usecases.summary.result: A concise recap and checklist of open items
usecases.files.title: Build slides or translate documents
usecases.files.action: Turns rough notes into a presentation deck or translates a PDF while preserving layout.
usecases.files.result: A ready-to-share PowerPoint deck or translated PDF
usecases.rumor.title: Verify a market rumor
usecases.rumor.action: Launches a Deep Research job to gather and weigh primary evidence on both sides of the claim.
usecases.rumor.result: A cited brief laying out the supporting and contradicting evidence
usecases.index.title: Replicate an index
usecases.index.action: Fetches the underlying series and recomputes the index from its published methodology in a Jupyter notebook.
usecases.index.result: A comparison chart plotting the replicated series against official figures
usecases.quote: Fluent text is cheap; every request should end in verifiable work.
bets.title: Built so enterprise work survives process failures
bets.subtitle: Virtual Actor identities, OTP fault isolation, live Worker channels, disposable compute, and PostgreSQL transactions keep long-running work recoverable.
bets.actors.title: Sessions keep their identity across restarts
bets.actors.body: Every active Session runs as a Virtual Actor with a stable address, durable state, mailbox, lifecycle, and exact recovery checkpoint.
bets.otp.title: Faults stay local to one conversation
bets.otp.body: Elixir/OTP supervision trees isolate any branch that hangs, times out, or crashes, reconstructing its progress from PostgreSQL while every other Agent continues uninterrupted.
bets.fabric.title: Live control over running Agents
bets.fabric.body: A dedicated Phoenix Channel per Worker multiplexes environment tool calls, Codex Job control, checkpoints, and backpressure while the control plane drives the main conversation loop.
bets.computer.title: Dedicated, replaceable Agent computers
bets.computer.body: Agent Computer runs shell commands, Codex Jobs, Automation scripts, headless browsers, and local files. Worker process state can be rebuilt at any time because PostgreSQL owns committed domain facts.
bets.ledger.title: PostgreSQL owns durable completion state
bets.ledger.body: Messages, turns, schedules, authorization decisions, and delivery intents commit transactionally to PostgreSQL. Live streams show progress; PostgreSQL defines what actually happened.
quickstart.title: Run the full Harness
quickstart.subtitle: Launch on a single Linux, macOS, or Windows host with Docker Compose, deploy to Kubernetes in production, or run straight from source.
quickstart.tabs.docker: Docker Compose · Recommended for single host
quickstart.source.note: Install the pinned toolchains with the repository setup script, then start the full local stack with bun dev.
quickstart.docker.note: Run this Compose stack on any Linux, macOS, or Windows machine capable of running Linux Docker containers. It brings up PostgreSQL, Function Runtime, the control plane, and Caddy HTTPS, and launches one dedicated Worker container per Agent.
quickstart.k8s.body: The official Helm chart deploys verified control-plane, Function Runtime, and Worker images alongside bundled or external PostgreSQL, backed by PVC or S3 storage, and provisions one dedicated Worker Pod per Agent.
quickstart.k8s.link: Read the full Kubernetes deployment guide
cta.title: Give your company a shared Brain
cta.body: Self-host Ankole on infrastructure you control. Your company's context stays on your servers, and model or search requests go only to the providers you configure.
